name: Backend Services
description: Node.js backend services including REST APIs, email delivery, KAS (Key Authentication Service), and Netlify serverless functions that relay secrets securely to the browser.
purpose: Handle server-side logic, secret relay, stateful operations, and external API proxying that cannot be performed safely in the browser.
inputs: HTTP requests from the UI layer (/api/*)
outputs: Outbound HTTP requests to external services (PayPal, SAM.gov, GitHub)

keyFiles.role: GitHub token relay — MUST be the only GitHub token relay
SAM.gov API key relay — MUST be the only SAM.gov relay

securityRules: All relay endpoints apply per-IP rate limiting
CORS restricted to approved origins in production
Return { auth: boolean, token: string|null, api_error: string|null } shape from all relay endpoints
